Title: Hydroponic Green Onions: pH, Spacing, Regrowth & Harvest
Description: Grow hydroponic green onions at pH about 6.5 in half-strength nutrient, germinate at 61–75 °F, and cut at 6 in. Tops regrow; seed crops take 60–80 days. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
Keywords: hydroponic green onions, hydroponics, indoor gardening, grow vegetables indoors
